entries.name: Tape Stop
entries.evidence: The manual and the page describe an audio effect that slows a signal to a halt the way a tape does, and can follow a clock.

entries.name: PUSH
entries.evidence: Two programmable buttons the player presses to send gates and triggers. That is the catalog's manual gate rule, as with Sfeo PUSHR and Fully Wired Quad Manual Gate.

entries.name: GS1-O
entries.evidence: Built around a CEM3340 oscillator chip. The page lists a V/Oct input, sync, and five waveform outputs.

entries.name: Bruxa
entries.evidence: A delay line with several taps, a wet/dry blend, and filters inside its feedback paths. The filters belong to the delay, so the delay decides the category.

entries.name: Warps
entries.evidence: The quickstart lists seven ways of combining two audio signals. Three of them are ring modulation and wavefolding, which the catalog files under FX, and the other four also process audio. The built-in oscillator only stands in for a missing carrier. A review on 2026-11-05 left this row empty because the keyword rule said LFO, which is wrong for an audio processor.

entries.name: Collapse
entries.evidence: An analog stage that lowers an audio signal's sample rate. The page compares it with a digital bit crusher, which the catalog files under FX.

entries.name: Crush
entries.evidence: An analog stage that lowers an audio signal's sample rate, with a mix control. The page compares it with a digital bit crusher, which the catalog files under FX.

entries.name: VC Bend
entries.evidence: Processes control voltages. The page's feature list has a full wave rectifier and a CV amplifier, and owner decision 17 files rectifiers under UTIL. The keyword rule would have said LFO.

entries.name: Prism
entries.evidence: A stereo buffer built on a delay line, with a lo-fi decimation stage, freeze, and one optional filter stage. The maker mentions a filter and a looper too, but both are parts of this one effect chain.
